QUOTE: "Define the `MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` macro in the module's public header under `include/mbedtls/`" and "Regenerate `library/error.c` with `scripts/generate_errors.pl` ... Do not edit the generated arms directly."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gets "header define, then regenerate, don't hand-edit error.c". But it never says the string comes from the `/** */` doc comment on the `#define`. It adds a separate step to put the description text in the generator's data input and says it doesn't know where that text lives. That contradicts the item's mechanism.
